messages:
Alex Rivera: Quick microcopy question — in the Console logs view the hover tooltip for the little copy icon currently says `Copy`. Should we add a platform shortcut hint? e.g. `Copy to clipboard (⌘C)` or `Copy (⌘/Ctrl+C)`?
Marta Chen: I usually like showing shortcuts for power users, but we should keep the visible tooltip short. Maybe show just `Copy` visually and expose the shortcut in a persistent helper or on focus.
Kevin O'Neill: Accessibility note: tooltips are not always read by screen readers. If we show a short label visually, we should provide a descriptive aria-label like `Copy request payload to clipboard` for the button itself.
design-bot: Screenshot attached of current tooltip text: `Copy` (no shortcut).
Alex Rivera: Okay — proposed compromise: visible tooltip stays as `Copy`, add a smaller subtle helper on hover/focus that shows `⌘/Ctrl+C`, and ensure button has `aria-label="Copy request payload to clipboard"`. Is that too many layers?
Marta Chen: That sounds good. For the helper, prefer `Cmd/Ctrl + C` wording? Localization team prefers `⌘/Ctrl+C` since symbols are shorter. Also avoid punctuation clutter.
Kevin O'Neill: +1. Also make sure keyboard focus exposes the helper text (not only hover) for keyboard users.
Alex Rivera: I'll update the spec: 1) Tooltip text: `Copy` 2) Hover/focus helper (visually subtle): `⌘/Ctrl+C` 3) Button aria-label: `Copy request payload to clipboard` 4) Add note: helper must be reachable by keyboard focus and screen reader should not be blocked.
Marta Chen: Small nit — in Figma the helper currently uses an em dash. Use a simple inline label (no em dash) to simplify translations.
Kevin O'Neill: Filing a quick PR checklist: update Figma, change tooltip string in i18n key `console.copy_button.tooltip`, add aria label key `console.copy_button.aria`, and add a small a11y test verifying aria-label present.
Alex Rivera: Awesome — I'll put the Figma changes on my to-do and tag you both in the PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
Marta Chen: Thanks!
Kevin O'Neill: Thanks — will review the PR tomorrow.
